The NLP community has witnessed a surge of research interest in improving pre-trained models. This article presents a comprehensive review of representative work and recent progress in the NLP field and introduces the taxonomy of pre-trained models.
title: Pre-Trained Language Models and Their Applications - ScienceDirect
